iteration_stopping: stop after two consecutive extensions whose paired reference-free MC CI includes zero or mean improvement is below 1e-4
staged_continuation: after the five-way pilot, continue only the factor with the largest paired improvement in all four benchmark-seed tasks, subject to a 1200-second (+25% B5) pre-start ceiling

corrected_external_baselines.deep_bsde_original: raw amortized Y0 plus official-style nonshared BN/ReLU Z_n; no g or grad-g embedding
corrected_external_baselines.sdgd_pinn_original: ordinary tanh (t,x)->u plus authors' soft terminal value/gradient penalty; no hard terminal ansatz
corrected_external_baselines.deep_picard: reuse prior result; terminal construction belongs to published algorithm
corrected_external_baselines.full_history_mlp: reuse prior result; pathwise terminal evaluation belongs to published algorithm
corrected_external_baselines.scasml: reevaluate from corrected ordinary SDGD-PINN backbone
